title: देउवाको उत्तराधिकारी बन्ने चर्चामा आधा दर्जन नेता, शशांकको नाममा सहमति प्रयास
content:
काठमाडौं । नेपाली कांग्रेसका पूर्वसभापति शेरबहादुर देउवा समूहको समानान्तर महाधिवेशनको मिति नजिकिँदै छ । गगन थापा नेतृत्वको कार्यसमितिलाई अस्वीकार गरेको यो समूह महाधिवेशनको तीव्र तयारीमा जुटेको हो । देउवा समूहको महाधिवेशन मंसिर २१ देखि २३ गतेसम्म काठमाडौंमा हुँदैछ। संस्थापन पक्षले यसअघि नै पार्टीको १५औँ महाधिवेशन गरिसकेको छ। देउवा समूहमा रहेका अधिकांश नेता–कार्यकर्ता संस्थापन पक्षतिर लागिसकेका छन्। सर्वोच्च अदालतबाट आधिकारिकता पाउने दाबीसहित देउवाले बेग्लै महाधिवेशन गर्न लागेका छन् । आधिकारिकतासम्बन्धी मुद्दामा सर्वोच्चले निस्सा दिएको छ। त्यसैले आधिकारिकता आफूहरूले नै पाउने यो समूहको दाबी छ। यद्यपि, मुद्दाको सुनुवाइ कहिले हुन्छ भन्ने निश्चित छैन । त्यसबारे देउवाले भन्ने गरेका छन्, ‘पार्टी सभापति म छु, मैले महाधिवेशन गराएको पनि छैन, मैले कसैलाई हुन्छ भनेको पनि छैन। हामीले अदालतमा मुद्दा हालेका हौँ। अदालतबाट न्याय पाउँछौँ।’ दुईवटा महाधिवेशन भएपछि कांग्रेस विभाजन भइसकेको छ। सर्वोच्चको अन्तिम फैसलापछि मात्रै त्यसले औपचारिकता पाउने देखिन्छ। देउवाले आफूले महाधिवेशन गराएर पार्टी नेतृत्वबाट बिदा हुन चाहेको सार्वजनिक रूपमै प्रस्ट पारिसकेका छन्। देउवा अब नदोहोरिने निश्चित भएपछि पार्टी सभापतिमा आकाङ्क्षा राख्ने नेताहरू बिस्तारै खुल्दै गएका छन्। महाधिवेशन तयारी समितिका संयोजक डा. शशांक कोइराला, प्रकाशमान सिंह, विमलेन्द्र निधि, कृष्णप्रसाद सिटौला, डा. प्रकाशशरण महत र एनपी साउदको नाम अहिलेसम्म चर्चामा छ। त्यसो त देउवाले कार्यवाहक सभापति तोकेका पूर्णबहादुर खड्का पार्टी विभाजनमा जान नहुने भन्दै पछि हटेपछि शशांकलाई संयोजक बनाइएको थियो। खड्कासहित १४औँ महाधिवेशनमा देउवासँग प्रतिस्पर्धा गरेका डा. शेखर कोइराला पनि अहिलेसम्म कतै खुलेका छैनन्। त्यसैले समानान्तर महाधिवेशन संयोजक कोइरालालाई नै सभापतिको उम्मेदवार बनाउने विषयमा नेताहरूबीच छलफल भइरहेको एक नेताले बताए। ती नेताका अनुसार शशांकलाई नेतृत्वमा अघि सार्न देउवा पनि सकारात्मक छन्। महाधिवेशनबाट शशांकको नाममा सहमति बन्ने सम्भावना बलियो रहेको ती नेताले दाबी गरे। ती नेताले नेपाल प्रेससँग भने, ‘यसअघि शशांक दाइलाई संयोजक बनाउने बेलामा पनि सर्वसम्मत भएको हो। अब महाधिवेशनबाट पनि उहाँलाई नै शेरबहादुर दाइले अघि सार्नुहुन्छ जस्तो देखिन्छ।’ ती नेताका अनुसार शशांकलाई सभापति बनाउने विषयमा प्रकाशमान सिंह, विमलेन्द्र निधि र कृष्णप्रसाद सिटौला पनि सकारात्मक छन्। शशांकलाई अघि सार्नुको कारण उनको राजनीतिक विरासत पनि हो। उनी कांग्रेसका संस्थापक नेता तथा नेपालका प्रथम जननिर्वाचित प्रधानमन्त्री बीपी कोइरालाका छोरा हुन्। त्यसो त प्रकाशमान सिंह पनि गणेशमान सिंहका छोरा हुन्। गणेशमान प्रजातन्त्र पुनःस्थापनाका लागि भएको जनआन्दोलनका सर्वोच्च कमान्डर तथा कांग्रेसका शीर्ष नेता थिए। विमलेन्द्र निधिका पिता महेन्द्रनारायण निधि कांग्रेसका वरिष्ठ नेता थिए। सभापतिको आकाङ्क्षीका रूपमा हेरिएका सिंह र निधि १४औँ महाधिवेशनमा पनि उम्मेदवार बनेका थिए तर पछि देउवालाई सघाए। सभापतिको आकाङ्क्षीका रूपमा हेरिएका अर्का नेता हुन्, कृष्णप्रसाद सिटौला। कांग्रेसको केन्द्रीय राजनीतिमा लामो समयदेखि सक्रिय सिटौला १३औँ महाधिवेशनमा सभापतिको उम्मेदवार बनेका थिए। शशांक १३औँ महाधिवेशनबाट कांग्रेसको महामन्त्री निर्वाचित भएका थिए। यद्यपि, देउवा समूहमा नेतृत्वका आकाङ्क्षी अन्य नेताहरू पनि छन्। प्रकाशशरण महत र एनपी साउदले पनि सभापतिका लागि आफ्नो दाबी प्रस्तुत गर्ने चर्चा छ। ती नेताले भने, ‘उहाँहरू (महत र साउद) ले सहमति भयो भने ठिकै छ, चुनावी प्रतिस्पर्धा हुने अवस्था आए मात्रै सभापतिमा उम्मेदवारी दिने गरी आन्तरिक तयारी गरिरहेको बुझेका छौँ।’ नेता साउदले आफू अहिले जिल्ला अधिवेशनमा केन्द्रित रहेको बताए। उनले भने, ‘म अहिले जिल्ला अधिवेशनमा केन्द्रित छु। महाधिवेशनलाई सफल बनाउनका लागि हामी लागिरहेका छौँ।’ उनले आफू सर्वसम्मत रूपमा नेतृत्व चयन गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने पक्षमा रहेको बताउँदै दाबी गर्ने वा नगर्नेबारे कुनै निष्कर्षमा नपुगेको सुनाए। ‘प्रतिस्पर्धा हुने अवस्था आए चुनाव लड्नुहुन्छ ?’ भन्ने नेपाल प्रेसको जिज्ञासामा उनले थपे, ‘मेरो प्राथमिकता सहमति हो। साथीहरूसँग छलफल पनि चलिरहेको छ। चुनाव नै लड्ने भन्ने निर्णय मैले अहिलेसम्म गरेको छैन। परिस्थितिमा निर्भर हुन्छ।’ सहमतिमै नेताहरूको जोड अर्का नेता गुरु बरालले पनि नेतृत्व चयनमा सहमति जुटाउने प्रयास रहने बताए । उनले भने, ‘अहिलेसम्म नेतृत्वको विषयमा छलफल भएको छैन। अब प्रदेश अधिवेशन सकिएपछि छलफल हुन्छ। तर, शीर्ष तह सहमतिमै हुनुपर्छ भन्नेमा छ। हामीले पनि उहाँहरूमध्ये कुनै एकजनाले मूल नेतृत्व सम्हालेर बाँकी नेताहरू सल्लाहकार तथा अभिभावकीय भूमिकामा बसिदिनुहोस् भन्ने आग्रह गरेका छौँ।’ महाधिवेशन तयारी समितिका सचिवालय सदस्य दीपकप्रसाद कुइँकेलले पनि नेतृत्व चयन सर्वसम्मत रूपमा हुनुपर्छ भन्नेमा जोड रहेको बताए। उनले भने, ‘अहिलेसम्म नेतृत्वका बारेमा छलफल भएको छैन। लोकतान्त्रिक पार्टी हो, नेताहरू को-कसले तयारी गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ होला। तर, सर्वसम्मत गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने कुरा पनि भइराखेको छ।’ आकाङ्क्षी धेरै भए स्वतः प्रतिस्पर्धा हुने उनले बताए। साथै, शशांक कोइराला संयोजक भएकाले उनकै नाममा सहमति हुन्छ भन्ने चर्चा चल्नु स्वाभाविक रहेको उनको भनाइ छ। कुइँकेलले थपे, ‘उहाँ (शशांक) संयोजक भएको नाताले उहाँको नाममा सहमति हुन्छ भन्ने कुरा आइहाल्छ। अरू नेताहरूको पनि कुरा चलिराखेको छ। कसको नाममा सहमति हुन्छ, त्यो अहिले टुङ्गिसकेको अवस्था छैन।’ उनले देउवाले अहिलेसम्म कसैलाई पनि ‘हुन्छ’ नभनेको जिकिर गरे। ‘सभापतिमा जसको नाममा सहमति हुन्छ, शेरबहादुर दाइको समर्थन उहाँलाई नै हुन्छ,’ उनले भने, ‘त्यसैले अहिलेसम्म कसैको नाममा सहमति भएको छैन।’ महाधिवेशन प्रक्रिया कहाँ पुग्यो ? देउवा समूहले सातै प्रदेशको अधिवेशन सम्पन्न गर्ने गरी कार्यतालिका सार्वजनिक गरेको छ। महाधिवेशन सचिवालय समितिका संयोजक कुइँकेलका अनुसार प्रदेश अधिवेशन मंसिर ५ गतेदेखि सुरु हुनेछ। निर्धारित कार्यतालिकाअनुसार मंसिर ५ गते गण्डकी, ७ गते लुम्बिनी, १३ गते कर्णाली, १४ गते मधेश, १५ गते सुदूरपश्चिम, १७ गते कोशी र १९ गते बागमती प्रदेशको अधिवेशन हुनेछ। प्रदेश अधिवेशनको उद्घाटनका लागि पूर्वसभापति देउवा सातै प्रदेशमा पुग्ने कार्यक्रम रहेको कुइँकेलले बताए। उनका अनुसार हालसम्म देउवा समूहले ४८ जिल्लाको अधिवेशन सम्पन्न गरिसकेको छ। त्यस्तै, १४० निर्वाचन क्षेत्रमा समेत क्षेत्रीय अधिवेशन सम्पन्न भएको छ। ‘कार्यतालिकाअनुसार नै महाधिवेशन प्रक्रिया अघि बढिरहेको छ। महाधिवेशनअघि जिल्ला र प्रदेश अधिवेशन सम्पन्न गर्ने गरी काम भइरहेको छ,’ कुइँकेलले भने । Kathmandu. The date of the parallel general convention of the Nepali Congress group led by former president Sher Bahadur Deuba is approaching. This group, which has rejected the Gagan Thapa-led working committee, is busy preparing for the general convention. The Deuba group's general convention is being held in Kathmandu from November 21 to 23. The establishment faction has already held the party's 15th general convention. Most of the leaders and activists in the Deuba group have already moved towards the establishment faction. Deuba is going to hold a separate general convention with the claim of getting official recognition from the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court has given its verdict on the issue of official recognition. Therefore, this group claims that they will get official recognition. However, it is not certain when the case will be heard. Regarding this, Deuba has said, 'I am the party president, I did not hold a general convention, I did not tell anyone to do so. We have filed a case in court. We will get justice from the court.' The Congress has split after two general conventions. It seems that it will only be formalized after the final verdict of the Supreme Court. Deuba has publicly made it clear that he wants to step down from the party leadership by holding a general convention. With Deuba certain that he will not be re-elected, leaders aspiring to be party president are gradually opening up. The names of the coordinators of the General Convention Preparation Committee, Dr. Shashank Koirala, Prakash Man Singh, Bimalendra Nidhi, Krishna Prasad Sitaula, Dr. Prakash Sharan Mahat, and NP Saud are still in the news. In fact, Shashank was made the coordinator after Purna Bahadur Khadka, who was appointed as the acting president by Deuba, withdrew, saying that the party should not split. Dr. Shekhar Koirala, who competed with Deuba in the 14th general convention along with Khadka, has also not been revealed yet. Therefore, a leader said that discussions are underway among the leaders to make Koirala, the coordinator of the parallel general convention, the candidate for the presidency. According to the leader, Deuba is also positive about promoting Shashank to the leadership. The leader claimed that there is a strong possibility of a consensus being reached in the name of Shashank from the general convention. The leader told Nepal Press, 'Earlier, there was a unanimous consensus when Shashank Dai was made the coordinator. Now, it seems that Sher Bahadur Dai will put him forward from the general convention as well.' According to the leader, Prakash Man Singh, Bimalendra Nidhi, and Krishna Prasad Sitaula are also positive about making Shashank the president. The reason for promoting Shashank is also his political legacy. He is the son of BP Koirala, the founding leader of the Nepali Congress and the first elected Prime Minister of Nepal. Prakashman Singh is also the son of Ganeshman Singh. Ganeshman was the supreme commander of the people's movement for the restoration of democracy and a top leader of the Nepali Congress. Bimalendra Nidhi's father, Mahendra Narayan Nidhi, was a senior leader of the Nepali Congress. Singh and Nidhi, who were seen as presidential aspirants, were also candidates in the 14th General Convention but later supported Deuba. Another leader seen as a candidate for the presidency is Krishna Prasad Sitaula. Sitaula, who has been active in the central politics of the Nepali Congress for a long time, was a candidate for the presidency in the 13th General Convention. Shashank was elected as the General Secretary of the Nepali Congress at the 13th General Convention. However, there are other leaders in the Deuba group who are also aspiring for leadership. There is talk of Prakash Sharan Mahat and NP Saud also presenting their claims for the post of President. The leader said, "We understand that they (Mahat and Saud) are making internal preparations to nominate themselves for the presidency only when there is an electoral contest." Leader Saud said that he is currently focused on the district convention. He said, 'I am currently focused on the district convention. We are working to make the general convention a success.' He said that he is in favor of unanimously selecting the leadership, but has not reached any conclusion on whether to claim it or not. When asked by Nepal Press whether he would contest the election if there is a competitive situation, he added, "My priority is consensus. Discussions are also underway with friends. I have not yet decided whether to contest the election. It depends on the situation." Leaders insist on consensus Another leader, Guru Baral, also said that efforts will be made to reach a consensus on the selection of leadership. He said, "So far, there has been no discussion on the issue of leadership. Now, the discussion will take place after the provincial convention. However, the top level should be in agreement. We have also requested that one of them take over the main leadership and the remaining leaders should sit in advisory and guardian roles." Deepak Prasad Kuinkel, a secretariat member of the general convention preparation committee, also stressed that the leadership selection should be unanimous. He said, "There has been no discussion about the leadership yet. It is a democratic party, so who are the leaders preparing? However, there is also talk that it should be unanimous." He said that if there are many aspirants, there will automatically be competition. He also said that since Shashank Koirala is the coordinator, it is natural for there to be discussions that a consensus will be reached in his name. Kuinkel added, "Since he (Shashank) is the coordinator, there is talk that an agreement will be reached in his name. Talks are also ongoing about other leaders. It is not yet clear in whose name an agreement will be reached." He claimed that Deuba has not said 'yes' to anyone yet. 'The one whose name is agreed upon for the presidency will have Sher Bahadur Dai's support,' he said, 'that is why no agreement has been reached on anyone's name yet.' Where has the general convention process gone? The Deuba group has made public the schedule to hold conventions in all seven provinces. According to Kuinkel, coordinator of the General Convention Secretariat Committee, the provincial conventions will begin on November 20. According to the scheduled schedule, the convention of Gandaki Province will be held on Mangsir 5, Lumbini on the 7, Karnali on the 13, Madhesh on the 14, Sudurpaschim on the 15, Koshi on the 17, and Bagmati Province on the 19. Kuinkel said that former President Deuba is scheduled to visit all seven provinces to inaugurate the provincial conventions. According to him, the Deuba group has so far completed conventions in 48 districts. Similarly, regional conventions have also been held in 140 constituencies. "The general convention process is moving forward as per the schedule. Work is underway to hold district and provincial conventions before the general convention," Kuinkel said.

चयन गर्नुपर्छ भन्ने पक्षमा रहेको बताउँदै दाबी गर्ने वा नगर्नेबारे कुनै निष्कर्षमा नपुगेको सुनाए। ‘प्रतिस्पर्धा हुने अवस्था आए चुनाव लड्नुहुन्छ ?’ भन्ने नेपाल प्रेसको जिज्ञासामा उनले थपे, ‘मेरो प्राथमिकता सहमति हो। साथीहरूसँग छलफल पनि चलिरहेको छ। चुनाव नै लड्ने भन्ने निर्णय मैले अहिलेसम्म गरेको छैन। परिस्थितिमा निर्भर हुन्छ।’ सहमतिमै नेताहरूको जोड अर्का नेता गुरु बरालले पनि नेतृत्व चयनमा
